remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March 1946. . . . No signature." Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Note: There is no sunflower listed in the 1941 or 1942 exhibitions. This is probably No. 4 in the O'Keeffe exh. at Amer. Place, Mar.–May 1943. This exh. included ptgs. done in 1942 and 1943." Whitney Archive dates 1942? Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks date 1942. Backing inscription dates 1940. (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Sunflower

description: Two bright yellow sunflowers with dark brown, textured centers dominate the composition. Small green leaves poke out from behind the larger, leftmost flower. A softly shaded orangish brown background fills the work's negative space.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
